history.text: The Maravi confederacy gave the country its name.
David Livingstone reached Lake Nyasa and publicised the slave trade there.
Multi-party elections ended thirty years of one-party rule under Hastings Banda.

worthSeeing.title: Lake Malawi National Park:
worthSeeing.text: Clear water and hundreds of endemic cichlid species, a UNESCO site.

worthSeeing.title: Mount Mulanje:
worthSeeing.text: A granite massif rising abruptly from the tea estates of the south.

worthSeeing.title: Liwonde National Park:
worthSeeing.text: Elephants and hippos along the Shire River.
